title: The wand
starting_code: # Walk to the stone, pick up the wand, and walk to me.
hints: Use `move_right` to walk to the stone first. Then you can grab what is on it!
Use `pick_up` with empty brackets to take the wand.
After you pick it up, you need one more `move_right` instruction to reach me.
intro: I went ahead and left my spare wand on the flat stone for you. It is only lent, so we will have to give it back one day. Pick it up and walk on to me!
outro: Now you have a wand of your own! Well, a lent one. Let's see what you can do with it!
learned: Now you know that things are objects too, and how to pick them up.
